description: This file defines a utility class SemanticsLabels that provides semantic labels for player markers in a Tic-Tac-Toe game, with specific labels for 'X' and 'O' players.

classes.name: SemanticsLabels
classes.description: A utility class providing semantic labels for game markers, distinguishing between different players and empty cells.

methods.name: markerLabel
methods.description: Returns a semantic label for a player's marker with game-specific labels.
